nodes.po_osz.text.t: Stach snorts, but the corner of his mouth twitches. "Knows nothing, 'cause he saw nothing, 'cause I hide things well. But I remember. If you're ever hungry, you know where to find me. Not in the woods. I'm never in the woods."

nodes.po_wyd.options.[dalej].text.t: I get it, I get it.

nodes.po_wyd.text.t: Stach doesn't answer straight away. "I know he knows. I moved the snares across the stream and learned not to look at you. Everyone's got something on his conscience, but at least I don't pretend I haven't."

nodes.powitanie.options.[q1_sidla].text.t: The gamekeeper says those are your snares in the wood.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: A skinny fellow crawls out from behind a beech, with a sack on his back and the face of a man who was never here. "Me? In the woods? What, a man can't pick pine cones now?"

nodes.q1_oszczedz.text.t: Stach frowns as if looking for the catch. "You saw nothing? Fine. And I did nothing. Only remember, the snares in the wood are under the beech, not the oak, if anyone asks." With a wave of his hand he lets you know he's in your debt now.

nodes.q1_rozmowa.options.[wydaj].text.t: I'll tell the gamekeeper where the snares are.

nodes.q1_rozmowa.text.t: Stach lets out a breath as if he'd been holding it for a week. "Mine, not mine. The kid's hungry, the wife's coughing, and the Emperor takes tax on every hen. The snares are for hares, the roebucks walk in by themselves, 'cause they're stupid. Will you tell the gamekeeper, or let a man live?"

nodes.q1_wydaj.text.t: Stach spits at your feet and won't meet your eyes. "Go on, then. But mark this: a man who sells out a poor wretch once carries somebody on his conscience for good. Even when he's in the right."
